title: APS guide for WeSchool to Bamberg exchange students
intro: You have been selected for a WeSchool exchange at the University of Bamberg. Start by confirming with your international office whether APS group verification is required for your cohort. If Process A is confirmed, you register individually, while the universities arrange the group and coordinate payment and submission.

This guide covers a short-term exchange in which you remain enrolled at your home institution and do not receive a German degree. APS verifies academic records; it does not grant university admission or issue a visa. Your WeSchool selection, Bamberg admission and visa application are separate milestones.

Use the numbered journey in order. Documents can be gathered while the institutions arrange the group. Follow the confirmed cohort instructions at registration and payment checkpoints. Mark a step complete only after you have the evidence described in that step.
gate: Ask WeSchool and Bamberg to confirm in writing whether this cohort needs Process A group verification, qualifies for an exemption, or must follow another route. The German Missions visa page lists an APS-certificate exemption for non-German-degree studies. APS also publishes Process A for institutional exchanges. These statements concern related but different requirements; neither is permission to assume the cohort route.

If the institutions confirm that no APS procedure is needed, retain their instruction and the relevant exemption evidence and continue with Bamberg admission and the applicable visa process. Stop the APS registration and payment path.

If Process A applies, obtain the group instructions and use this guide. If there is a German degree, a double degree, an uncertain qualification category, an existing APS account, or an earlier refusal, ask for case-specific instructions before registering or paying. Do not create a duplicate account to resolve uncertainty.

stages.title: Keep your selection record
stages.purpose: Turn your selection into a clear set of next actions and a record you can refer to throughout the exchange.
actions: Save the WeSchool selection or nomination email. Note the host university, intended exchange semester, approximate stay and the programme in which you remain enrolled.
Identify the WeSchool international office contact and ask who coordinates the APS group. Record an official email address, the student handover deadline and how the office wants documents delivered.

Create a private exchange folder with separate areas for identity records, education records, APS registration, payment evidence and university correspondence. Keep originals secure and prepare working copies.
Check that your passport details are available and accurate. If a passport is missing, expiring or being renewed, tell the coordinator early and ask how that affects nomination and APS registration.
stages.check: Selection is not Bamberg admission. Do not describe yourself as admitted until Bamberg issues its admission letter. Do not invent travel dates or use an old cohort deadline.
stages.complete: You have the selection record, the correct coordinator and a list of the next university deadlines.
stages.branch: If the host, semester or programme is incorrect, resolve it with WeSchool before entering the details into any application.

stages.title: Confirm whether APS Process A applies
stages.purpose: Establish the correct procedure before you create a registration or incur a fee.
actions: Ask the coordinator to confirm that you are part of a recognised institutional exchange, remain enrolled at WeSchool and will not receive a German degree. The published Process A leaflet describes bachelor or master enrolment at the Indian partner institution.

For a PGDM or another diploma, ask WeSchool and Bamberg to confirm that the qualification and cohort are accepted for Process A and how the qualification must be entered on the APS form. Write the actual award title; do not relabel a diploma as a master's degree.

Ask whether the non-German-degree visa certificate exemption or a qualifying publicly funded scholarship applies to you. The Process A leaflet describes European publicly funded awards meeting the current monthly BAfoeG threshold. Ask the offices to confirm the current applicable conditions for your award; having any scholarship is not enough.

If you already registered, paid or received an APS result, give the coordinator the existing reference privately and request instructions. The leaflet excludes candidates previously refused in the individual procedure because of fraudulent documents.
stages.check: A dMAT exemption for an officially confirmed exchange does not mean exemption from APS group verification. TestAS and university or visa language requirements must also be distinguished from the APS process.
stages.complete: The universities have confirmed the route and explained any exemption, PGDM entry or existing-account issue that applies to you.
stages.branch: Exemption confirmed: retain proof and move to the admission and visa handover. Route unclear: continue gathering documents, but pause registration and payment.

stages.title: Complete the Bamberg exchange application
stages.purpose: Keep the university application moving alongside APS preparation.
actions: WeSchool selects and nominates candidates. After nomination, watch for the application link emailed by Bamberg's International Office; check spam as well as your inbox.
Open the university link and follow the current HISinOne exchange application instructions. Prepare the requested forms and photograph and submit them by the deadline given for your semester.
Review your name and passport details against your identity documents. Check that you selected the exchange semester and programme corresponding to your nomination.
Monitor the application platform and your registered email for missing items. After review, download and retain the official Bamberg admission letter from the platform.
stages.check: The public Bamberg page currently lists 15 May for winter-semester applications and 1 December for summer-semester applications. Recheck it and your invitation for the relevant year; WeSchool may set an earlier internal deadline.
stages.complete: You have submitted the exchange application and recorded its status. Retain the admission letter when issued.
stages.branch: If no invitation arrives after nomination, ask WeSchool to confirm nomination and contact Bamberg using its official exchange channels. Do not create an unrelated degree application.

stages.title: Obtain the institutional group instructions
stages.purpose: Ensure your individual registration can be linked to the correct university group.
actions: The Indian or German institution contacts APS at groups@aps-india.de with the cooperation agreement details, selected candidate list and representatives' contact information. APS assigns the group number to the institutions.
Ask the coordinator to share the confirmed group number, registration instructions, payment arrangement, document handover deadline and the office responsible for collective dispatch.
Confirm that the group list uses the same name, date of birth and student details as your documents. Give corrections to the coordinator before the group packet is finalised.

Gather documents while the group is being arranged. Treat coordinator confirmation as the practical checkpoint before registration/payment; the public form does not establish that a group number is a technical prerequisite for creating an account.
stages.check: Do not invent a group number or enter it into an unrelated field. The leaflet requires it on the group envelope and transfer reference. A single application without an assigned group number cannot be allocated to the group.
stages.complete: You know your group reference and have the cohort's written instructions for registration, payment and document collection.
stages.branch: If group instructions are pending, keep preparing documents. The coordinator should resolve the group arrangement with APS; do not independently courier an unallocated application.

stages.title: Gather the required documents
stages.purpose: Build a complete packet using the exchange checklist rather than the individual graduate checklist.
actions: Open the APS checklists page and download Process A and the current Student Authorisation Letter. Check that your cohort has not received newer written instructions from APS.
Collect the common documents in the document checklist. Obtain the original enrolment statement from WeSchool and ask the coordinator which academic category applies to your PGDM.

For a confirmed postgraduate/master category, prepare your bachelor's certificate, every bachelor semester marksheet and all available current university marksheets. For a confirmed bachelor category, prepare the Class XII certificate and all bachelor marksheets to date.

Keep your Class X and XII details available for the public form even where a particular certificate is not listed in the Process A postgraduate packet. Distinguish information needed to fill a field from documents required in the submitted packet.
The signed application and payment receipt become available later. Track them as pending items rather than declaring the packet complete prematurely.
stages.check: Send copies of academic degrees, diplomas, certificates and marksheets. The original enrolment statement is specifically required by the Process A list and is an exception to the academic-originals warning.
stages.complete: All preparatory documents are available, with remaining post-registration/payment items clearly identified.
stages.branch: If a certificate, semester result or enrolment statement is unavailable, ask the coordinator what APS will accept. Do not substitute a different document or a self-written declaration without confirmation.

stages.title: Check every document against the form
stages.purpose: Catch discrepancies before submission so the information on paper and online agrees.
actions: Compare your passport name, date and place of birth, Aadhaar and academic records. Flag spelling differences, initials, changed names or an updated passport to the coordinator; do not edit official scans to make them match.
Check that copies are legible, in colour and A4 size, with both sides where relevant. Keep seals, signatures, grades, certificate numbers and page edges visible.
If a record is only in an Indian regional language, arrange a notarised English translation as required by APS. English or bilingual records generally do not need notarisation solely for APS.
Arrange semester records in chronological order and verify that each completed semester is represented. Identify the awarding university separately from the college or institute.

Use recorded percentages and CGPA. If conversion is required, obtain the institution's official rule; do not use an internet conversion formula or manufacture a passing year for an unfinished programme.
stages.check: Do not upload or circulate credentials, identity documents or the group's personal records in public class chats. Use the institution's designated channel for document handover.
stages.complete: Your documents are readable, your details agree, and unresolved discrepancies have a documented next action.
stages.branch: Missing or inconsistent record: correct it through the issuing institution or obtain coordinator/APS instructions, then repeat the check.

stages.title: Create your APS account
stages.purpose: Create your personal registration using the official public APS form and the confirmed group instructions.
actions: Start at https://aps-india.de and choose the application/register link. The public application page checked for this guide is https://aps-india.de/aps-process/. Read its information and acknowledgement before continuing.
Keep your documents and coordinator instructions beside you. Use a working email account you will continue to access during the exchange. Enter it twice carefully and check for spelling mistakes.
Choose a username and a strong, unique password. The current public form specifies a minimum of seven characters. Store your own credentials privately.
Prepare the required photograph upload. The public form currently requests JPG or JPEG up to 30 KB. Resize a copy, check that it remains clear and retain the original photograph.

Use the form-field guide for personal and education sections. Inspect each screen as you go. The portal may change; if a required field cannot be answered truthfully, obtain clarification instead of entering filler data.
stages.check: The group leaflet tells students to register like individual applicants; it does not establish a separate Exchange button or group-number input on the public form. Do not look for invented controls. Resolve payment handling with the coordinator before final submission.
stages.complete: Your registration details have been reviewed and you have retained any reference or confirmation actually provided by the portal.
stages.branch: Technical error or no usable confirmation: retain the error text, date and reference if available, then contact the coordinator/APS. Do not repeatedly create accounts or pay again.

stages.title: Complete education and other form sections
stages.purpose: Represent your actual academic history accurately, including completed degrees and current study.
actions: Enter Class X and XII details from the relevant board records. Where a centre number is requested, use the correct examination record. If a detail does not exist, ask before entering a guessed number.
For bachelor's education, distinguish the university awarding the degree from the college attended. Enter the exact course, duration, specialisation, completion status and recorded result.

Enter current postgraduate/diploma study using the classification confirmed for your cohort. The form has separate master's and additional degree/diploma areas. A PGDM must retain its actual title; the applicable section requires confirmation.

Complete test and language fields only as applicable to your actual qualifications and current official requirements. The form displaying a test section does not establish that you must sit that test.

Read the education-verification fields carefully. The public form includes academic portal login and professor-email fields. Any requested credentials belong only in the authentic APS channel if applicable; this guide does not collect them.
stages.check: Officially confirmed exchange programmes are exempt from dMAT under the current APS guidance. APS currently says TestAS is not mandatory for its verification. University and visa language/test conditions are separate; confirm those independently.
stages.complete: Every applicable section reflects the source records, and the coordinator has resolved any PGDM or mandatory-field ambiguity.
stages.branch: If a mandatory field forces an inaccurate answer, stop at that point and seek APS instructions through the coordinator. Do not choose a false qualification or fabricated score to proceed.

stages.title: Review print and personally sign
stages.purpose: Make the signed paper record consistent with the online registration.
actions: Before finalising, compare the completed application with your passport and academic records. Recheck email, contact number, institution names, status, marks and course details.

Follow the coordinator-confirmed group instructions for completing the registration/payment interface. Retain the actual registration confirmation, completed application and any available application reference. Do not assume a draft has been submitted.
Print the completed application and personally sign wherever required. The Process A leaflet also requires a personally signed authorisation form.

Download the current Student Authorisation Letter from the checklist page. Fill your name, birth date, date and place and sign it. Read every declaration, including those about recognition and authenticity; ask for clarification if you cannot truthfully make a declaration.
Keep a copy of the exact signed set you hand over. Check that no signature page is missing and that printed pages match the final submitted details.
stages.check: Do not sign blank forms, ask someone else to sign for you or assume an unsigned printout is sufficient. Post-login print/download controls must be followed as actually presented by the portal.
stages.complete: You hold the completed, personally signed application and authorisation letter, with a retained copy.
stages.branch: Error discovered after submission: notify the coordinator/APS with your reference and ask how to correct it. Do not silently change only the printed copy or register again.

stages.title: Complete the coordinated group payment
stages.purpose: Make one correctly referenced group payment and keep evidence for every application.
actions: The Process A leaflet currently states INR 18,000 per applicant and requires the group fees to be transferred collectively in one amount, quoting the APS group number. Processing starts once the collective fee is credited.

Ask the coordinator who collects student contributions, who makes the collective APS transfer, and what evidence each student receives. Reconfirm the current fee and bank details against the official leaflet and any newer APS instructions.

The general portal recommends CCAvenue and displays individual payment fields. This differs from the group leaflet. Follow the specific group instructions confirmed by APS through the institutions; do not independently choose online payment or invent offline-payment entries.

If you contribute to the institution, retain that receipt. Also obtain the relevant copy of the actual collective APS transfer receipt for your packet; a student contribution receipt alone is not proof that APS received the group payment.
Match the paid student count to the final group list. For illustration only, five students at INR 18,000 each total INR 90,000; use your actual confirmed group size and current fee.
stages.check: APS fees are non-refundable. Do not pay twice because a portal status has not updated. No account number is reproduced here: the payer should use the live official source and confirmed institutional instructions.
stages.complete: The designated payer has retained the collective transfer evidence, the group reference is correct and the coordinator has confirmed the next submission action.
stages.branch: Payment failed, deducted without confirmation, or form demands an unconfirmed individual payment: pause and raise the transaction/reference details through the coordinator or APS contact form before any repeat payment.

stages.title: Hand over the packet for collective submission
stages.purpose: Submit a complete, traceable group application through the responsible institution.
actions: Use the final handover checklist: signed application, signed authorisation, photograph, identity copies, required academic copies, original enrolment statement, coordinator details and collective fee receipt.
Order each student's packet consistently and label it as instructed by the coordinator. Ask for an acknowledgement of handover and keep a scan of your own completed packet.

The institution checks the full candidate list, cooperation documents, current representative contacts and fee evidence. The Process A leaflet requires all group applications to be submitted together.

The responsible office marks the group envelope clearly with the APS-assigned group number, checks the current APS mailing address and arranges post/courier. Students should not independently send a separate unallocated packet.
Retain the courier receipt, tracking number and delivery record at group level. Courier delivery confirms delivery of a packet, not completeness, payment reconciliation or successful verification.
stages.check: The FAQ lists: Academic Evaluation Centre India, Gate No. 3, DLTA Complex, R.K. Khanna Stadium, 1 Africa Avenue, 110029 New Delhi, India. Recheck before dispatch. Personal drop-offs and unsolicited emailed packets do not replace the published submission process.
stages.complete: Your handover is acknowledged and the coordinator has retained the group dispatch and delivery evidence.
stages.branch: Packet incomplete: return to document collection/review. Delivery delayed or returned: the dispatching office follows up with the courier and checks address/instructions before resending.

stages.title: Follow verification and hand over to visa preparation
stages.purpose: Respond to verification requests and obtain confirmation of the group outcome through the correct channel.
actions: Monitor your registered email and coordinate with the international office. If APS requests additional records, provide the exact requested items through the specified channel and retain the request and response.

If an institution has not responded to verification, ask its examinations/records office to respond through an official institutional channel. APS says private email confirmations cannot replace official institutional verification.

Treat the university coordinator as the primary group contact. An account status or courier delivery alone is not proof of a successful Process A outcome. There is no guaranteed group turnaround date in the leaflet.

For Process A, APS emails the result to the concerned German university; applicants do not receive an individual APS certificate. Ask Bamberg to confirm your outcome and tell you what group verification or exemption evidence to use for the visa process.

Retain the admission letter, verified cohort instructions, relevant result/exemption confirmation and your references. Open the current German Missions visa guidance and follow the route for your circumstances. Admission, finance, insurance and other visa requirements must be checked separately.
stages.check: Do not wait for an individual digital APS PDF on the group route. APS verification does not guarantee a visa. Process A is tied to the exchange; changes to the German university/programme require the applicable institutional and APS instructions.
stages.complete: Bamberg has confirmed the relevant result or the universities have confirmed the exemption path, and you know what evidence to use for visa preparation.
stages.branch: Additional documents requested: return to collection and review, then respond. No result near your deadline: escalate through the coordinator with references and dates; avoid repeated duplicate enquiries.

documents.name: Completed APS application
documents.detail: Produce after online registration. Check that the final printed details match the online submission.

documents.name: Student Authorisation Letter
documents.format: Current form, completed and personally signed
documents.detail: Download from the checklist page. Read all declarations; complete name, birth date, date, place and signature.

documents.name: Passport-size photograph
documents.format: Photo for the packet and upload copy
documents.detail: The leaflet asks for a passport-size photo. Separately, the current web upload specifies JPG/JPEG up to 30 KB. Do not assume visa photo specifications are identical.

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.detail: The leaflet specifies Aadhaar with a linked mobile number. Check the current record and keep that number accessible. It does not establish an OTP step in the APS form.

documents.name: Passport first and last pages
documents.detail: Include the pages required by the leaflet and both sides where applicable. Raise a renewal or name discrepancy before registration.

documents.name: Indian and German coordinator details
documents.format: Official email addresses and phone numbers
documents.detail: Use the current representatives. The group arrangement also needs up-to-date institutional contact information.

documents.name: APS collective fee transfer receipt
documents.format: Copy of group bank transfer evidence
documents.detail: Obtain from the designated payer/coordinator. Check the group reference; retain your contribution receipt separately if applicable.

documents.name: Indian institution enrolment statement
documents.detail: Obtain from the authorised institution office. Check your identity, current programme and enrolment details. This is specifically an original in the exchange checklist.

documents.name: Class XII certificate
documents.detail: Required by the bachelor list. For a postgraduate category, retain school details for online fields and submit school copies only if required by the applicable instructions.

documents.name: Bachelor marksheets to date
documents.format: Copies of all available university marksheets
documents.detail: Put completed-semester records in order; ask how to handle unavailable or pending records.

documents.name: Bachelor certificate and all bachelor semester marksheets
documents.detail: Include the degree/certificate and complete semester set. Do not send original academic awards or result sheets.

documents.name: Current university marksheets
documents.format: Copies of all available university marksheets
documents.detail: Include records of the current programme as applicable. For PGDM, confirm the category and required current-study records with WeSchool/APS.

documents.name: English translations
documents.who: Documents only in an Indian regional language
documents.format: Notarised English translation with the relevant document copy
documents.detail: English/bilingual records generally do not require additional translation or notarisation solely for APS.

form.title: Create Account
form.fields: Create Username; Password; Enter password again; Upload Image
form.how: Use a unique username and password. The current form shows a minimum password length of seven characters and a JPG/JPEG photograph upload up to 30 KB. Make a compressed copy of the photograph; confirm that it stays readable.
form.watch: Do not save credentials in this guide or share them with classmates. Portal requirements may change.

form.title: Personal Details
form.fields: Firstname; Lastname; Email and confirmation; Gender; Nationality; Date and Place of Birth; Indian citizenship; Aadhaar; Passport; contact numbers; address
form.how: Use your passport as the reference for your legal name and birth details. Enter the working email twice. Copy identity numbers directly from records and check digit by digit. Use an address and contact number at which you can reliably receive communication.
form.watch: For a single name, a changed name, an unusual passport format or an unresolved Aadhaar mismatch, obtain APS instructions rather than improvising a name split or placeholder number.

form.title: Education Details I
form.fields: Class 10 board, year, centre number, percentage; Class 12 board, year, centre number, percentage; JEE scores where applicable
form.how: Copy the board's name and recorded results from your documents. Class X board, passing year and percentage are visibly required on the public form. Keep the underlying records ready even when they are not in your Process A academic packet.
form.watch: A form field is not a new instruction to take JEE or supply an unrelated document. For grades without a percentage or missing centre details, follow the issuing institution's rule and APS guidance.

form.title: Education Details II
form.fields: Diploma; Bachelor's; Master's; Additional Degree/Diploma; institution, course, duration, specialisation, status and results
form.how: Distinguish the awarding university from the college. Use the programme's actual title. Mark completed bachelor studies as completed and current study truthfully. Enter the result using the applicable percentage/CGPA fields. Follow the confirmed classification for a PGDM.
form.watch: Do not describe an unfinished programme as completed, guess a passing year or rename PGDM to MBA/Master. If the portal will not accept a truthful entry, ask APS through the coordinator.

form.title: Academic verification details
form.fields: Student Login ID; Student Password; Professor Email where shown
form.how: The public form includes academic portal login fields and professor-email fields for certain qualifications. Read any current on-screen explanation. Provide only the applicable requested information directly through APS; use a genuine institutional contact if requested.
form.watch: Never enter personal email, banking or unrelated passwords as an academic portal password. Do not invent a professor contact. If no portal/contact is available, obtain instructions instead of fabricating one.

form.title: TestAS Details
form.fields: Core and subject score; subject field; test date
form.how: Enter only actual, applicable results. The current APS FAQ says TestAS is not mandatory for APS verification; a field appearing on the form does not require you to book a test.
form.watch: Officially confirmed exchange programmes are exempt from dMAT under current APS guidance. dMAT and TestAS are different tests; recheck the rules if your programme changes.

form.title: Language Details
form.fields: Language chosen; English certification and result; German certification, level and score
form.how: Use genuine certificates and exact scores/levels where applicable. The public form lists English and German certificate fields. APS does not set a specific language level for verification; Bamberg and the visa authority set their own requirements.
form.watch: Do not manufacture an IELTS, TOEFL or German result or assume that a blank APS language section waives Bamberg/visa requirements. Ask about any mandatory field that does not apply.

form.title: Payment Details
form.fields: Payment method; payer; amount; payment date; bank; IFSC; transaction reference where shown
form.how: Pause until you have the APS-confirmed group instructions. The Process A leaflet requires one collective transfer quoting the group number, while the general form shows CCAvenue/offline options. Enter only the actual transaction details in the manner specified for your group.
form.watch: Do not claim you paid individually when the institution paid collectively. Do not enter INR 0, a fake reference or an unconfirmed method to bypass the screen. Retain the actual group receipt.

example: Fictional example: Riya Example has completed a BCom and is currently enrolled in a PGDM. Her bachelor section describes the completed BCom and its awarding university. Her current qualification stays titled PGDM. She obtains instructions on the correct diploma/current-study section and Process A category; she does not select completed Master merely to proceed. No example in this guide is an actual student record.
trouble: Ask WeSchool and Bamberg to confirm the route and evidence in writing. Keep preparing records, but pause APS registration/payment. Visa certificate exemptions and institutional verification requirements must be checked separately.
PGDM does not match a form category
Use the exact qualification title and ask the coordinator to obtain APS guidance on both eligibility and the correct field. Do not infer equivalence to a master degree.
A record or result is unavailable
Ask the issuing office for the proper record and tell the coordinator what is missing. Obtain instructions on any acceptable substitute; do not submit an assumed replacement.
Flag the discrepancy and ask which official correction or supporting evidence is needed. Do not manipulate certificates, marksheets or identity scans.

Check your email/spam and retain the actual error and any reference. Contact APS via the official form through the coordinator where appropriate. Do not assume successful registration or create repeated accounts.
Payment deducted or status not updated
Retain the transaction evidence, payer, amount, date and group number. Ask the designated payer/coordinator to reconcile it with APS before any repeat transaction.
Ask the records/examination office to reply to APS through an official institutional channel. Private email confirmations do not replace official records verification.
Courier says delivered but no result
Retain delivery proof and coordinate through the institutions. Delivery does not prove that the packet is complete or that verification succeeded. Avoid duplicate status enquiries.
For Process A this is expected: APS informs the German university. Ask Bamberg to confirm your result and the evidence to use for visa preparation.
Inform WeSchool and Bamberg before taking further steps. The Process A leaflet limits the route to the exchange and gives conditions for changes; obtain case-specific instructions.
cohort: Confirmed procedure or exemption and evidence
Student registration instructions and target date
Fee per student and date reconfirmed
Collective transfer reference and receipt location
Dispatching office and dispatch target date
Courier tracking and delivery evidence location
Bamberg result confirmation and visa evidence
Guide reviewer and next review date
handover: Confirmed route and group instructions received
Identity and education details checked against source records
PGDM classification or other qualification question resolved
Completed application printed and personally signed
Current authorisation letter completed and personally signed
Original enrolment statement and required academic copies included
Current Indian and German coordinator contacts included
Actual collective APS fee receipt included
Copy of my completed packet retained and handover acknowledged
Group dispatch and result follow-up responsibility confirmed
review: Before each new cohort, the international office should recheck the live checklist links, leaflet version, fee, bank instructions, registration fields, mailing address, exemptions and visa guidance. Replace dates and contacts using current institutional instructions.

The Process A leaflet checked here is dated 28 November 2023 and was still linked by APS on the verification date. The newer general form/FAQ does not resolve every group-specific detail. Route-specific instructions govern the Process A description; any newer written direction from APS for the cohort must be reconciled by the institutions.

The institutional route confirmation, PGDM classification and group payment interface are real coordinator checkpoints. This guide is not an assertion that APS has approved a particular WeSchool batch. The checklists describe completion of preparation; checking a box is not proof of submission or APS approval.

This edition verified public pages only. It did not create an account, pay a fee, submit documents or inspect authenticated screens. Instructions beyond the public form describe the official process and tell students what evidence to retain, rather than inventing post-login buttons.
